name: routine-one-to-one
about: A weekly 1:1. One open action was done, one open question was answered, and John took on one new thing with a date. The rest is conversation.

note.body:
roster - done
lock-in = nov 14
I'll write Marcus's reference letter, she needs it by the 15th
S. back from Portugal, looks rested
note.transcript:
John: How was Portugal?
Sarah: So good. We did almost nothing for nine days. I read four novels.
John: I'm jealous. Okay, what have you got?
Sarah: The volunteer roster, I sent it to you Monday night. It's in your inbox, all forty names with phone numbers.
John: I saw it, thank you. That's everything I needed.
Sarah: And the lock-in. I asked the youth leaders and the only weekend that works for everyone is November fourteenth.
John: The fourteenth it is then.
Sarah: One ask. Marcus is applying to the seminary and he needs a reference letter from you. The application closes on the fifteenth.
John: Of this month? Sure, I'll write it. I'll have it done by the fifteenth.
Sarah: He'll be thrilled. That's all I have.
John: Easy one. Go enjoy the jet lag.
